_why: saleor-dashboard (React SPA, no backend; CSS modules + macaw-ui component library + GraphQL codegen). 890 claims total: 729 css_selector unused, 91 dom_selector unresolved, 63 css_token_use unresolved, 3 env_var unused, 2 css_token_def unused, 2 dom_attr unresolved; zero GraphQL claims (all 698 graphql fields connected/uncertain). Claims concentrate in *.module.css files across src/channels, src/productTypes, src/orders, src/components — i.e. wherever CSS modules are consumed from TSX. I judged 43 (12 per kind seed 0, all if fewer): 37 FALSE, 6 TRUE. Only 2 of 731 css_selector symbols repo-wide are connected — the scanner cannot see JSX className / styles-object usage at all, which alone accounts for ~82% of all claims.
